class.name: actuo_rviz_plugins/ServoPanel
class.description: Per-joint servo (torque) on/off for an actuo bus servicer. Shows the jump enabling each joint would cause BEFORE the button is pressed, using the would_jump the server precomputed -- the panel never re-derives the safety rule, and never sends force.

class.name: actuo_rviz_plugins/DiagnosticsPanel
class.description: Read-only view of /diagnostics. Splits each status into publisher and item name, groups rows by the first path segment (bus first), colours OK/WARN/ERROR/STALE distinctly, and marks the whole panel stale when diagnostics stop arriving.
